injected_env_vars.name: PLANET_ID
injected_env_vars.description: Unique planet identifier (UUID). Injected by Launcher from local planet config.

injected_env_vars.name: PLANET_NAME
injected_env_vars.description: Human-readable planet name (e.g. 'andromeda'). Injected by Launcher.

injected_env_vars.name: TUNNEL_FQDN
injected_env_vars.description: Fully-qualified domain name of the Cloudflare tunnel (e.g. planet.scareverse.net). Injected by Launcher.

injected_env_vars.name: CENTRALHUB_URL
injected_env_vars.description: CentralHub base URL (e.g. https://hub-staging.scareverse.net). Injected by Launcher from centralhub.url config.

injected_env_vars.name: CENTRALHUB_SERVICE_TOKEN
injected_env_vars.description: Bearer token for authenticating requests to CentralHub. Injected by Launcher from vault.
